weeklyPlan.footerNote: Recovery and sleep are part of the program, not a pause from it.

items.title: Get your personal plan

items.title: Train and progress
items.description: Follow daily workouts, log weights and reps — the program grows with you.

items.question: Do I need special equipment?
items.answer: No. Many programs are designed for bodyweight training. For programs with weights, we note what equipment you'll need before the workout starts.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Yes, anytime — right in the app's account settings, no need to contact support, no penalties.

items.question: What payment methods are supported?
items.answer: Cards and local payment methods via Stripe and PayPal, YuKassa for Russian cards, and USDT via your own crypto wallet with automatic transaction verification.

items.question: Does the app work offline?
items.answer: DonatelloX is a PWA (Progressive Web App): the interface and previously viewed workouts are available offline, and progress syncs once you're back online.

items.question: Is the app available in my language?
items.answer: Yes, the interface and content are available in several languages.
